title: CDS Full Length Mock Test 13 (Hard Level)
description: Combined Defence Services Examination style full-length mock covering English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge. Hard level, 100 questions.
instructions: There is a penalty of 0.83 marks for every wrong answer.
No marks will be deducted for unattempted questions.
Choose the most appropriate option among the four given choices.
The paper covers English, Elementary Mathematics and General Knowledge as in CDS.
Use of calculator or electronic device is not permitted.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: Neither of the two battalions / have received / the winter clothing / so far.
questions.explanation: Neither is singular; use has received.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: The officer as well as / his men were / ready for the / night operation.
questions.explanation: With as well as the verb agrees with the first subject: was ready.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: It is high time / that the government / take firm steps / against infiltration.
questions.explanation: After it is high time the verb is in past: took firm steps.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the error: Scarcely had the convoy / left the base / than an IED / exploded on the road.
questions.explanation: Scarcely is followed by when, not than.

questions.subject: English
